name: SmartIcon
description: Advanced state machine that morphs SVGs based on semantic context.

options.name: icons
options.description: Map of state names to SVG strings.

options.name: defaultState
options.description: Initial semantic state used before any hover interaction resolves.

options.name: useSemanticTags
options.description: Resolve smart states from semantic HTML tags such as links and buttons.

options.name: transitionDuration
options.description: Morph transition time in ms.

options.name: switchDelay
options.description: Minimum ms a state must be requested before committing to the next icon.

options.name: size
options.description: Size of the icon container.

options.name: color
options.description: Color applied to the icon container. SVGs that use `currentColor` will inherit it. If empty, the icon keeps its original fill.

options.name: offset
options.description: Fixed offset from the pointer position.

options.name: anchor
options.description: Alignment (center, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right).

options.name: followStrategy
options.description: Whether the icon smoothly follows the pointer or snaps to it.

options.name: rotateWithVelocity
options.description: Rotate the icon based on movement velocity.

name: SmartRing
description: A reactive ring that distorts with velocity and adapts to stuck elements.
code:
import { SmartRing } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(SmartRing({ size: 24, color: '#f59e0b', enableSkew: true }));

options.name: size
options.description: Base diameter.

options.name: hoverSize
options.description: Diameter when hovering interactive elements.

options.name: color
options.description: Border color.

options.name: fill
options.description: Background fill color.

options.name: borderWidth
options.description: Border thickness in pixels.

options.name: mixBlendMode
options.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the ring element.

options.name: enableSkew
options.description: Distort the ring based on velocity (stretch and rotate).

name: Sparkles
description: Emits particle trails based on movement velocity.
code:
import { Sparkles } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(Sparkles({ color: '#f59e0b', frequency: 10 }));

options.name: color
options.description: Particle color.

options.name: count
options.description: Number of particles in the pool.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Pixels of movement required to spawn a particle. Lower values for a denser trail.

options.name: decay
options.description: Fade rate (0-1 per second). Higher values make for faster fading.

options.name: scatter
options.description: Random position offset for particle spawning.

name: TextRing
description: Rotates text around the cursor position.
code:
import { TextRing } from '@supermousejs/labs';

app.use(TextRing({ text: 'LOADING • ', radius: 40 }));

options.name: text
options.description: Text content.

options.name: radius
options.description: Ring radius in pixels.

options.name: fontSize
options.description: Text size in pixels.

options.name: speed
options.description: Rotation speed in degrees per second.

options.name: color
options.description: Text color.

options.name: opacity
options.description: Opacity of the rendered ring container.

options.name: className
options.description: Optional CSS class added to the container.

options.name: spread
options.description: Stretch the text to fit the entire circle using cross-browser letter-spacing.
